tidyfeed is a command-line tool that cleans up RSS and Atom feeds.

## Why tidyfeed?

Feeds are often a mess: duplicate entries, broken dates, mixed encodings. tidyfeed removes the duplicates, normalizes dates to ISO 8601, and converts all text to UTF-8. On a 2023 laptop it processes a 50 MB feed in about 3 seconds.

## Installation
